FIELD NOTES / A MORE CONSIDERED INTERNET

The art of noticing.

The best ideas rarely arrive fully formed. They begin as something small: a line in a book, a conversation that stays with you, a question you can’t quite put down.

Pay attention to what catches your attention. There is a reason it stopped you. Save a little of it for later.

A good collection isn’t about keeping everything. It’s about remembering what moved you.

An editable draft stays private.
